nt.lnn.cach_tinh: Lunar age (tuoi mu) = the year you plan to build − your lunar birth year + 1. Kim Lau (Golden Tower): lunar age divided by 9 leaves 1, 3, 6 or 8. Hoang Oc (house-age count): age 10 Nhat Cat (Fortunate), 20 Nhi Nghi (Fitting), 30 Tam Dia Sat (Earth Harm), 40 Tu Tan Tai (Gaining Wealth), 50 Ngu Tho Tu (Longevity Wanes), 60 Luc Hoang Oc (Deserted House), with the years in between counted on. Tam Tai (Three Calamities): three years in a row, set by the zodiac triad of your birth year. If you were born in January or early February before Tet, count from the previous lunar year.
